title: What I have built and tested.
dim: Hands-on work across my degrees, teaching and independent projects.
lede: The skills behind my work, with where I used each one and a link to the evidence.

items.what: Python for data preparation, feature engineering and model evaluation in my MSc dissertation, and for the cryptography exercises I designed for master's students.
Taught homomorphic encryption and the Paillier cryptosystem on a master's Applied Cryptography module, with Python exercises on encrypting values, combining ciphertexts and decrypting results.
Phishing URL detection comparing eight classifiers on a 70/30 split, evaluated with confusion matrices and ROC curves, then built into a web prototype for SMEs.
Disk image acquisition and examination in academic forensic exercises, with findings written up as reports.
Hands-on Microsoft Azure exercises in networking, identity and storage, being written up as documented labs. Not yet certified.
ZeroSeal, Citizen and Omela, built and deployed independently.
